# RigGamer — PC Gaming Guides, News & Reviews
# https://riggamer.com

RigGamer is an independent PC gaming editorial desk covering free-to-play games, hardware benchmarks, tier lists, and patch notes. All reviews are scored on our own rigs with no sponsored content.

## Sections
- Guides & Tier Lists: https://riggamer.com/guides/
- News & Patch Radar: https://riggamer.com/news/
- Benchmarks & Reviews: https://riggamer.com/reviews/
- PC Setup & Hardware: https://riggamer.com/setup/

## Games Covered
- Arknights: Endfield (Strategy RPG, PC)
- Neverness to Everness (Urban Open World, PC)
- War Thunder (Military Sim, PC)
- Enlisted (Tactical FPS, PC)
- RAID: Shadow Legends (Turn-Based RPG)
- Rise of Kingdoms (Strategy 4X)
- Star Trek Fleet Command (Sci-Fi 4X)
- Where Winds Meet (Open World RPG)
- Wuthering Waves (Action RPG, PC)
